data.name: Ingamar
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse, Ingamar means 'God of Ing, warrior'. Ing was an old Norse god associated with fertility, agrarian abundance, and the peace that comes from prosperity. The name Ingamar pays homage to both the divine and the warrior spirit.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of divine inspiration and warrior spirit.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ingamar reflects the rich Nordic heritage, bridging the gap between ancient Norse mythology and the Christian faith. data.spiritual_significance: The name Ingamar holds spiritual significance for those seeking a reminder of the divine presence and strength that resides within us as warriors in our own lives. It encourages the notion of fighting for what we believe in with courage, determination, and hope for abundance and prosperity.
